subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should explicit `heartbeat.session` always outrank event-provided wake session keys, and should default-account Telegram DMs continue to share `agent:<agent>:main` unless `session.dmScope` is configured?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence bug has a narrow fix, but changing Telegram DM defaults would alter a documented compatibility contract, so automation should not choose that product direction alone.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make configured heartbeat sessions win over event wake session keys, keep the documented DM default, and add diagnostics/docs for users who need DM isolation.

options.title: Change DM isolation defaults too
options.body: Default Telegram DMs to per-channel peer sessions, improving isolation but requiring an explicit upgrade/migration story for existing shared-main-session users.

options.title: Wait for the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on rebasing and reviewing the open fork PR as the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make configured heartbeat sessions win over event wake session keys, keep the documented DM default, and add diagnostics/docs for users who need DM isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current local blame points the central routing files to Peter's recent main history, and the choice is compatibility-sensitive enough for owner review.
